title.narrative: YRS civil society organisations within environment in Serbia
YRS civilsamhällesorganisationer inom miljösektorn i Serbien

description.narrative:
Organisationen Young Researchers of Serbia (YRS) har till Sida inkommit med en ansökan om finansiering med 16 miljoner kronor för att utföra programmet för Serbien "ECO SYSTEM Environmental Reforms Supporting Programme" under perioden 2019-2022. Insatsen syftar till att stärka det civila samhällets organisationers möjlighet att ta aktiv del i Serbiens EU närmande.
Det övergripande målet med programmet är att skydda naturresurser, försvara människors miljörättigheter, samt främja och institutionalisera förbättrat miljöskydd och stärka Serbiens EU reformer särskilt inom Kapitel 27.
Insatsen kommer att bidra till en effektiv operationalisering av resultatstrategin avseende Strategi Resultat R8 under strategiperioden och de kommande åren därefter.
Programmets totala budget är 16 miljoner kronor, varav organisationens egen insats är noll kronor. Det finns inga andra givare för programmet. Programmet kommer att vidareförmedla ungefär 7 miljoner kronor till lokala civilsamhällesorganisationer i Serbien.

The organisation Young Researchers of Serbia have requested from Sida finansing of 16 million SEK for their planned programme in Serbia 2019-2022. The contribution aims to strengthen civil society in order for it to be able to take a more active role in Serbia's EU integration process.
The goal of the programme is to protect the natural resources, defend people's environmental rights, promote and institutionalise improved environmental protection and other issues related EU reforms, and in particular with regard to Serbia's Chapter 27 process.
The contribution is expected to contribute to an efficient operationalisation of the Results Strategy in the startegy period, and specifically its Result 8.
The intervention total budget is 16 million SEK, out of which the organisation’s own funding is zero SEK.
Approximately 7 million SEK of the intervention budget will be forwarded to local civil society organisations in Serbia.

The programme objective:
Enforce the reforms in the environmental sector in Serbia through the more active involvement of CSOs in the implementation of EU acquis and constant cooperation of stakeholders.
Expected results:
1. Improved knowledge of CSOs and stakeholders about the environmental policy.
2. Improved dialogue and cooperation of institutions and CSOs on transposition and enforcement of environmental acquis in Serbia.
3. Raised public awareness and citizens' involvement in the reforms in the environmental sector.
4. Increased visibility and influence of environmental CSOs.
5. Preconditions set up for gender-sensitive planning in the environmental sector.

ECO SYSTEM Programme aimed to enforce the reforms in the environmental sector in Serbia through more active involvement of CSOs in the implementation of EU acquis and constant cooperation of stakeholders.
Some of the achieved results in relation to objectives of the intervention include the following:
Intermediate objective 1: Improved knowledge of CSOs and stakeholders about the environmental policy is accomplished by a mixture of different activities and methods, such as Online courses (https://obuke.mis.org.rs/), coordination meetings of supported networks and annual dialogue meetings, study visit to Slovenia and Croatia, advocacy visit to Brussels, capacity building of environmental CSOs on gender and mentoring, monitoring implementation of EU environmental policies on local level. Furthermore, capacity building activities of Environmental Impact Hub (Oikos support team) were designed to ensure the quality of project proposals and compliance with the objectives of the ECO SYSTEM Programme and to support grant implementation. The Hub also had a role to bridge local initiatives (activities of granted CSOs) with national decision-making processes. Additionally, synergies with other processes and projects brought new knowledge and opportunities for capacity building (e.g. EU4 Green project, EU for Green Agenda in Serbia, project Together for Environment etc.).
The intermediate objective 2: Improved dialogue and cooperation of institutions and CSOs on transposition and enforcement of environmental acquis in Serbia was very challenging because of political instability. Three parliamentary elections were held during ECO SYSTEM Programme implementation. This institutional instability caused a lack of activities on legislation improvement and policy development on the national level and a decrease in dialogue opportunities. However, YRS and Coalition 27 have managed to participate in numerous decision-making processes and took part in several working groups for policy/legislation development (e.g. working groups for Decree on ecological network, Environmental Strategy of the Republic of Serbia, Programme on nature protection, Strategy for implementation of Aarhus Convention, Action plan for implementation of the Water management Strategy of the Republic of Serbia).
YRSs Implementing Partners initiated numerous dialogues with decision makers in local communities, which eventually strengthened implementation of environmental acquis on local level.
One of the most sustainable outputs of this intermediate objective is development of methodology for monitoring implementation of environmental policy on a local level, which brings data and information for the production of the Green cards (https://www.koalicija27.org/zelene-karte/).
The intermediate objective 3: Raised public awareness and citizens' involvement in the reforms in the environmental sector is achieved and set a solid ground for future actions. Major campaigns were led by YRS, while supported CSOs implemented a number of actions aiming at citizens involvement and raising awareness by contributing to this joint objective. Multiple awareness-raising strategies, methods and tools were used to convey and spread messages, and to gather the support necessary to influence public opinion. The YRS campaign launched in 2020 to raise awareness among citizens that protecting the environment is everyones obligation and responsibility reached nearly 3 million people. At the same time, it boosted citizens involvement by enabling them to recognize and share local environmental issues thought Its up to you challenge. Online survey Access to information and participation in environmental decision-making at the local level was conducted in 2021 for the purpose of analysing the opinions and needs of the citizens regarding access to information and participation in environmental decision-making at the local level (1486 respondents submitted full survey). In 2023, campaign Save the forests and enjoy the holidays. As, every tree is a GOOD TREE together with supported networks engaged the community on preserving biodiversity and preventing climate change by organizing educational workshops in primary schools and through online campaign based on engaging the community and its media promotion. Over 400 pupils took part in educational workshops organized in their primary schools (13 Primary schools around Serbia, concretely in 10 places). Awareness raising campaign in 2024 was a success as well. Organizing the first group exhibition Dont buy Create! in 2024 dedicated to upcycling art by promoting responsible behaviour towards nature, YRS involved 75 students of art schools and free artists in this creative process, while promotion reached around 500.000 citizens.
Intermediate objective 4: Increased visibility and influence of environmental CSOs is fulfilled to a great extent. All 18 supported networks and especially 19 Implementing partners of the ECO SYSTEM Grant Forwarding process, increased their visibility and influence related to improving environmental policies and actions which is visible through follow up activities and initiatives. Approximately 55 % of supported Implementing partners accomplished high visibility in local communities. When it comes to their influence, approximately 60 % of organizations involved in ECO SYSTEM Programme (all Implementing partners and some partners organizations) have capacities to work on environmental policy and awareness raising which can be evidenced through 300 projects activities that are improving environmental policy.
Intermediate objective 5: Preconditions set up for gender-sensitive planning in the environmental sector was ambitiously set and work towards its achievement was prudently planned. CSOs have had increased knowledge on gender issues and by numerous activities of Implementing Partners regarding gender mainstreaming in the environmental sector, visible progress was made. The great and systematic support of involved gender experts has made CSOs understand better, to think, and work on the gender issue.
Gender-sensitive budgeting is also present among CSOs. But still a lot remains to be done, considering that the topic gender and environment is interlinked with many other elements of society and for making changes support is needed from institutions and from citizens.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
